question: Which user logins are frozen, and which returned users are still active?

steps.name: logins
steps.soql: SELECT UserId, IsFrozen FROM UserLogin WHERE IsFrozen = true LIMIT {limit}

steps.name: users
steps.soql: SELECT Id, Username, IsActive, UserType FROM User WHERE Id IN ({@logins.UserId}) ORDER BY Username

verdicts.say: {logins.rows} row(s) returned by the first query. Review selected columns, query limits and follow-up steps; this is not an org-wide assessment.

traps: The second query resolves the bounded first export only.
This is an administrative review; a freeze may be deliberate.
